shown.message:
I removed every process note from `refs/refs.bib` and pushed the result to `paper-repo` `dev`. I closed `idea-repo`#6. The citation keys are unchanged.

- **Notes:** all six `note` fields are gone from the entries. I also removed the header comment in the file and the process-note line in `refs/README.md`.
- **Pima:** the Pima entry (`smith1988pima`) is now confirmed against an OpenAlex record, with matching authors and pages 261–265.
- **Still not confirmed against a record:** the LightGBM entry and two of the four Arrhythmia authors. The paper doesn't cite either. I kept this status in the `positioning/` notes of this repo, not in the delivered bibliography.
- **Build:** the bibliography still builds with the same two harmless BibTeX warnings (Ghorbani has both volume and number; the Kolpaczki antithetic entry has no publisher).

`idea-repo`#2 is still open.
